subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should this PR land with the public `PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError` contract and exact-origin custom upload policy after the branch conflict is refreshed?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but merging permanently grants external adapters durable replay authority and tightens a shipped custom API-root behavior.

options.title: Accept and refresh
options.body: Keep the narrow public assertion and exact-origin policy, resolve conflicts, and rerun exact-head Plugin SDK and live upload validation.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Preserve the Slack timeout but replace the public assertion with an internal typed delivery outcome.

options.title: Preserve broader custom-host behavior
options.body: Retain the timeout and assertion while revising the custom API-root policy to support a documented broader upload-host contract.

recommendation.title: Accept and refresh
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow public assertion and exact-origin policy, resolve conflicts, and rerun exact-head Plugin SDK and live upload validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, authored the current safety design, and posted the land-ready proof.
